mainline/daming-duel#1.t: Daming Prefecture · East Gate Parade Ground

mainline/daming-duel#2.zh: 话分两头。且说那青面兽杨志，本是三代将门之后、五侯杨令公之孙，曾应武举，做到殿司制使。因押运花石纲，黄河风浪打翻了船，只得逃往他处避难。
mainline/daming-duel#2.t: Meanwhile, let us turn to Yang Zhi, the Blue-faced Beast. Descended from three generations of generals, grandson of Lord Yang of the Five Marquises, he passed the military exams and became an Imperial Guard commander. But while escorting a shipment of rare stones, his boat capsized in a storm on the Yellow River, and he had to flee.

mainline/daming-duel#3.zh: 后来遇赦，杨志携资回京求复旧职，却被高俅一笔批倒。盘缠使尽，只得变卖祖传宝刀；偏又遇泼皮牛二强夺，一时性起杀了牛二，亲往开封府自首，被刺配北京大名府。
mainline/daming-duel#3.t: Later he was pardoned and returned to the capital with money to buy back his post, but Gao Qiu struck him down with a stroke of the brush. With his money gone, he had to sell his family's heirloom sword. When the thug Niu Er tried to seize it, Yang Zhi killed him in a rage, turned himself in at Kaifeng, and was exiled to Daming, the Northern Capital.

mainline/daming-duel#4.zh: 留守梁世杰，人称梁中书，见杨志勤谨，有心抬举，又怕众将不服，便点集将校，在东郭门外教场演武试艺。
mainline/daming-duel#4.t: The garrison commander Liang Shijie, known as Secretary Liang, saw that Yang Zhi was diligent and wanted to promote him. Fearing the other officers would object, he gathered his commanders for a contest of arms at the parade ground outside the east gate.

mainline/daming-duel#5.zh: 我有心要抬举你做个军中副牌，月支一分请受，只不知你武艺如何？
mainline/daming-duel#5.t: I'd like to make you a deputy officer with a monthly stipend, but I don't know how good your martial skills are.

mainline/daming-duel#6.zh: 小人应过武举出身，曾做殿司府制使职役，这十八般武艺，自小习学。今日蒙恩相抬举，如拨云见日一般。
mainline/daming-duel#6.t: I passed the military exams and served as an Imperial Guard commander. I've studied the eighteen weapons since I was a boy. Your favour today is like the sun breaking through the clouds.

mainline/daming-duel#7.zh: 将台两边，大小军官列坐；四周军士分班围观。三通鼓罢，场中肃静。梁中书命杨志接连试艺，先由李成下场考校，再与周谨、索超较量。
mainline/daming-duel#7.t: Officers great and small sat on both sides of the reviewing stand; soldiers stood around in ranks. After three rolls of the drum, the ground fell silent. Secretary Liang ordered Yang Zhi to prove himself in a series of bouts: first Li Cheng would test him, then Zhou Jin and Suo Chao.

mainline/daming-duel#8.zh: 今日军中自家比试，枪刀本是无情之物，恐有伤损。可将枪头去了，用毡片包裹，蘸上石灰，白点多者当输。
mainline/daming-duel#8.t: Today is a contest among our own troops, and blades show no mercy; someone may get hurt. Take the heads off the spears, wrap them in felt and dip them in lime. Whoever has more white marks loses.

mainline/daming-duel#9.zh: 言之极当。众军各守行列，不许助战。
mainline/daming-duel#9.t: Very sensible. All troops keep to your ranks. No one is to join in.

mainline/daming-duel#10.zh: 俺是李天王李成。既要在大名府军中立足，先让俺试试你的本事！
mainline/daming-duel#10.t: I'm Li Cheng, the Heavenly King Li. If you want a place in the Daming army, let me test your skill first!

mainline/daming-duel#11.zh: 若蒙恩相差遣，安敢有违钧旨。请都监赐教！
mainline/daming-duel#11.t: Since Your Excellency commands it, how could I refuse? Please instruct me, Inspector!

mainline/daming-duel#12.zh:
第一场：独自与李成比试，将其体力压至四成以下（击倒也算）。
胜利：连续完成李成、周谨、索超三场比试。
失败：杨志倒下，或超过30回合。将台官员和四周军士只观战。
mainline/daming-duel#12.t:
Bout 1: Face Li Cheng alone and bring his HP below 40% (knocking him down also counts).
Victory: Complete all three bouts against Li Cheng, Zhou Jin and Suo Chao.
Defeat: Yang Zhi falls, or more than 30 turns pass. Officials on the stand and soldiers around the field only watch.

mainline/daming-duel#13.zh: 李成收住军器，点头道：“杨制使果然好武艺！”这一场考校已过，李都监退回将台。
mainline/daming-duel#13.t: Li Cheng lowered his weapon and nodded: "Commander Yang truly has fine skill!" The test was passed, and Inspector Li returned to the stand.

mainline/daming-duel#14.zh: 旗牌官叫两边收招，军士递水。杨志稍歇，重新整顿衣甲，体力、气力恢复，再听将令。
mainline/daming-duel#14.t: The flag officer called both sides to stand down, and soldiers brought water. Yang Zhi rested, straightened his armour, recovered his HP and Qi, and awaited orders.

mainline/daming-duel#15.zh: 杨志，你敢与周谨比试武艺高低？如若赢时，便迁你充其职役。
mainline/daming-duel#15.t: Yang Zhi, do you dare to match skills with Zhou Jin? If you win, you'll take his post.

mainline/daming-duel#16.zh: 这个贼配军，敢来与我交枪！
mainline/daming-duel#16.t: This convict dares to cross spears with me!

mainline/daming-duel#18.zh:
第二场：独自与周谨比枪，将其体力压至四成以下（击倒也算）。
杨志倒下或超过30回合失败；官兵只观战。
mainline/daming-duel#18.t:
Bout 2: Face Zhou Jin alone with spears and bring his HP below 40% (knocking him down also counts).
Defeat if Yang Zhi falls or more than 30 turns pass; the soldiers only watch.

mainline/daming-duel#19.zh: 李成收住军器，点头道：“杨制使果然好武艺！”这一场考校已过，李都监退回将台。
mainline/daming-duel#19.t: Li Cheng lowered his weapon and nodded: "Commander Yang truly has fine skill!" The test was passed, and Inspector Li returned to the stand.

mainline/daming-duel#20.t: The flag officer called both sides to stand down, and soldiers brought water. Yang Zhi rested, straightened his armour, recovered his HP and Qi, and awaited orders.

mainline/daming-duel#22.zh: 这个贼配军，敢来与我交枪！
mainline/daming-duel#22.t: This convict dares to cross spears with me!

mainline/daming-duel#24.zh:
第二场：独自与周谨比枪，将其体力压至四成以下（击倒也算）。
杨志倒下或超过30回合失败；官兵只观战。
mainline/daming-duel#24.t:
Bout 2: Face Zhou Jin alone with spears and bring his HP below 40% (knocking him down also counts).
Defeat if Yang Zhi falls or more than 30 turns pass; the soldiers only watch.

mainline/daming-duel#25.zh: 两个来来往往，斗了数十合。看周谨身上，白点三五十处；看杨志时，只有左肩胛下一点白。
mainline/daming-duel#25.t: Back and forth they went for dozens of bouts. Zhou Jin was covered in thirty or fifty white marks; Yang Zhi had only one, below his left shoulder blade.

mainline/daming-duel#26.zh: 量你这般武艺，如何南征北讨？教杨志替此人职役。
mainline/daming-duel#26.t: With skills like yours, how could you campaign north and south? Yang Zhi will take this man's post.

mainline/daming-duel#27.zh: 李成禀道：“周谨枪法生疏，弓马熟闲。再教周谨与杨志比箭如何？”梁中书应允，二人各领遮箭牌。
mainline/daming-duel#27.t: Li Cheng reported: "Zhou Jin is rusty with the spear but skilled with bow and horse. Why not have him compete with Yang Zhi in archery?" Secretary Liang agreed, and each took an arrow shield.

mainline/daming-duel#28.zh: 你先射我三箭，后却还你三箭。
mainline/daming-duel#28.t: You shoot three arrows at me first, then I'll return three to you.

mainline/daming-duel#29.zh: 轮到杨志，先虚扯弓弦，骗过防牌，再射一箭，只取不致命的左肩。众军士喝彩，将周谨扶到场边。
mainline/daming-duel#29.t: When Yang Zhi's turn came, he first plucked the string to fool Zhou Jin's shield, then loosed an arrow that took only the non-fatal left shoulder. The soldiers cheered, and Zhou Jin was helped off the field.

mainline/daming-duel#30.zh: 休要谢职！我和你两个比试。
mainline/daming-duel#30.t: Don't thank him for the post yet! You and I will have a contest.

mainline/daming-duel#31.zh: 周谨患病未痊，精神不在，因此误输与杨志。小将不才，愿与杨志比试武艺。
mainline/daming-duel#31.t: Zhou Jin is not yet over his illness and wasn't himself, so he lost to Yang Zhi by mistake. Unworthy as I am, I wish to test my skill against Yang Zhi.

mainline/daming-duel#32.zh: 你与索超比试武艺如何？
mainline/daming-duel#32.t: Will you test your skill against Suo Chao?

mainline/daming-duel#33.t: Your Excellency's orders, how could I refuse?

mainline/daming-duel#34.zh: 李成把惯战的马匹、披挂借与索超，叮嘱：“周谨是你徒弟，先自输了。小心在意，休教折了锐气！”梁中书也命取自己的战马借与杨志。
mainline/daming-duel#34.t: Li Cheng lent Suo Chao his own seasoned warhorse and armour, warning him: "Zhou Jin is your student and he's already lost. Be careful, don't let our spirit be broken!" Secretary Liang had his own warhorse brought for Yang Zhi.

mainline/daming-duel#35.zh: 旗牌官叫两边收招，军士递水。杨志稍歇，重新整顿衣甲，体力、气力恢复，再听将令。
mainline/daming-duel#35.t: The flag officer called both sides to stand down, and soldiers brought water. Yang Zhi rested, straightened his armour, recovered his HP and Qi, and awaited orders.

mainline/daming-duel#36.zh:
第三场：与急先锋索超较量，将其体力压至四成以下（击倒也算），证明足以任职。
杨志倒下或超过30回合失败；官兵只观战。
mainline/daming-duel#36.t:
Bout 3: Face the Vanguard, Suo Chao, and bring his HP below 40% (knocking him down also counts) to prove you're fit for the post.
Defeat if Yang Zhi falls or more than 30 turns pass; the soldiers only watch.

mainline/daming-duel#49.zh: 杨志与索超在教场中心翻翻复复，枪斧并举，各逞平生本事。两边军将不住喝彩。
mainline/daming-duel#49.t: Yang Zhi and Suo Chao fought round and round in the middle of the parade ground, spear against axe, each showing everything he had. The officers on both sides cheered without pause.

mainline/daming-duel#50.zh: 两个好汉，且歇！相公有令！
mainline/daming-duel#50.t: Both of you, halt! His Excellency commands it!

mainline/daming-duel#51.zh: 杨志、索超收住军器。李成、闻达一同禀道：“相公，据这两个武艺一般，皆可重用。”
mainline/daming-duel#51.t: Yang Zhi and Suo Chao lowered their weapons. Li Cheng and Wen Da reported together: "Your Excellency, these two are equally skilled. Both deserve high posts."

mainline/daming-duel#52.zh: 两个都是好本事！取银两、表里来赏赐，同升管军提辖使。
mainline/daming-duel#52.t: Both have real skill! Bring silver and fine cloth to reward them, and promote both to garrison commander.

mainline/daming-duel#53.zh: 杨志、索超拜谢受赏。索超心服，自此与杨志相敬。杨志连过三场，终于在大名府军中立住了脚。
mainline/daming-duel#53.t: Yang Zhi and Suo Chao bowed their thanks for the reward. Suo Chao was won over and respected Yang Zhi from then on. Having passed all three bouts, Yang Zhi had at last secured his place in the Daming army.

mainline/daming-duel#54.zh: 光阴迅速，转眼到了五月。梁中书备办十万贯金珠宝贝，要送往东京给蔡太师庆生辰。因杨志教场显过本领，便把这桩要紧差遣付托给他。
mainline/daming-duel#54.t: Time flew, and soon it was the fifth month. Secretary Liang prepared a hundred thousand strings' worth of gold and jewels to send to Grand Tutor Cai in Kaifeng for his birthday. Since Yang Zhi had proven himself on the parade ground, this important task was entrusted to him.

mainline/daming-duel#55.zh: 你若与我送得生辰纲去，我自有抬举你处。
mainline/daming-duel#55.t: If you deliver the birthday gifts for me, I'll see that you're promoted.

mainline/daming-duel#56.zh: 恩相差遣，不敢不依。若依小人，并不要车子，把礼物装做十余条担子，只做客人的打扮行货。
mainline/daming-duel#56.t: Your Excellency's orders, I dare not refuse. If I may, we should use no carts. Pack the gifts into a dozen or so carrying poles and dress as merchants hauling goods.

mainline/daming-duel#57.zh: 梁中书听从杨志安排，拣军士装作脚夫，另令谢都管和两个虞候随行，嘱众人一路听杨志提调。北京这一路先按下，且看东溪村晁保正庄上，又将生出甚么事来。
mainline/daming-duel#57.t: Secretary Liang followed Yang Zhi's plan, picking soldiers to dress as porters, and sent Steward Xie and two captains along, telling everyone to obey Yang Zhi on the road. Let us leave the Northern Capital for now and see what is about to happen at headman Chao's manor in East Creek Village.

mainline/daming-duel#58.zh: 杨志教场试艺，连过三场，受任提辖；梁中书因而委派他押送生辰纲。
mainline/daming-duel#58.t: Yang Zhi passes all three bouts on the parade ground and is made a commander; Secretary Liang entrusts him with the birthday gifts.

mainline/daming-duel#59.zh: 杨志与索超在教场中心翻翻复复，枪斧并举，各逞平生本事。两边军将不住喝彩。

mainline/daming-duel#69.zh: 杨志比试失利，未能通过教场考校。
mainline/daming-duel#69.t: Yang Zhi lost the contest and failed the parade-ground test.

mainline/daming-duel#70.zh: 三十回合已过，教场比试未能完成。
mainline/daming-duel#70.t: Thirty turns have passed and the parade-ground contest is unfinished.
